name: The Americana at Brand
description: The Americana at Brand in Glendale, California, is a premier open-air lifestyle destination that seamlessly blends upscale shopping, award-winning restaurants, AMC movie theaters, and world-class entertainment. Located just minutes from Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood, this beautifully designed center features contemporary architecture, lush landscaping, a central dancing fountain, and a charming trolley that creates a vibrant urban village atmosphere. With its unique mix of national retailers, luxury boutiques, and seasonal events like Winterland by Caruso, The Americana at Brand delivers an exceptional experience for both locals and visitors alike.
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in Glendale offering premium shopping, dining, entertainment, and year-round events in a beautifully landscaped urban village setting.
